test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 17th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct phrasal verb:

We need to ___ the unused documents before filing the new ones.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1 - clear out**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"clear out"** means to remove unwanted items or empty something completely. (साफ करना या खाली करना) • **Example: **I need to clear out my closet to make space for new clothes. • **"clear out" **is the correct phrasal verb to use in this context because it implies removing unused documents before filing new ones. (साफ करने के लिए सही वाक्यांश है क्योंकि यह अवांछित दस्तावेज़ों को हटाने का सुझाव देता है।) • **Example: **The office staff decided to clear out the old files before starting the new project. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 - clear out**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Go through **(जांचना या गुजरना): To examine carefully or to experience something, especially something difficult. • **Example:** She had to go through a lot of files to find the missing document. • **Turn over **(पलटना): To flip something or give control/responsibility to someone else. • **Example:** Please turn over the page to see the next question. • **Bring back **(वापस लाना): To return something or someone to its original place. • **Example:** Can you bring back the book I lent you? 3b:T8e8, The correct answer is **Option 2**.
